title: Line sketch: Psychedelic Circles Explode
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The artwork features overlapping concentric circles, spirals, and dotted organic shapes filling the entire frame in a dense, dynamic composition. Bold black outlines separate vibrant color fields, creating a rhythmic flow across the surface with no central focal point. The technique mimics fluid pouring or tie-dye effects with crisp, saturated layers (derived from painting #148).
